definitions.explanation: A motor vehicle, typically with four wheels.

examples.japanese: {自動車|じどうしゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きます→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I go to work by car.

examples.japanese: {自動車|じどうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{免許|めんきょ}→免許：03808_menkyo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}りたい→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: I want to get a driver's license.

examples.japanese: {自動車|じどうしゃ}⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}をつけて→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please be careful of car accidents.

examples.japanese: {自動車|じどうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{数|かず}→数：00204_kazu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{年々|ねんねん}→年々：10417_nennen⟧⟦{増|ふ}えて→増える：01183_fueru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The number of automobiles is increasing year by year.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{自動車|じどうしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{気|き}をつけて→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: There are many cars on this road, so please be careful.

notes:
{自動車|じどうしゃ} is the formal/official word for automobile or motor vehicle. In everyday conversation, ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧ is far more common.

USAGE:
{自動車|じどうしゃ} appears in official, legal, and technical contexts such as government documents, signage, news reports, and product descriptions. When speaking casually about cars, Japanese speakers almost always use ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧.

COMPOUNDS:
- {自動車|じどうしゃ}⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧: driving school (often shortened to ⟦{自校|じこう}→自校：noentry⟧ or ⟦{車校|しゃこう}→車校：noentry⟧)
- ⟦{自動車|じどうしゃ}{保険|ほけん}→自動車保険：26400_jidoushahoken⟧: car insurance
- {自動車|じどうしゃ}⟦{免許|めんきょ}→免許：03808_menkyo⟧: driver's license (formally ⟦{運転|うんてん}{免許|めんきょ}{証|しょう}→運転免許証：25263_untenmenkyoshou⟧)
- {自動車|じどうしゃ}⟦{税|ぜい}→税：03767_zei⟧: automobile tax
- {自動車|じどうしゃ}⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧: car accident

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{自動|じどう}→自動：03339_jidou⟧ (automatic/self-moving) + ⟦{車|しゃ}→車：00516_kuruma⟧ (vehicle). Literally "self-moving vehicle."
